description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named Grid3 that demonstrates multi-selection mode in a GridView, including custom adapter and layout classes.

classes.name: Grid3
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating multi-selection in a GridView with custom adapter and selection handling.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter providing views for app icons in the grid, loading icons dynamically.

classes.name: CheckableLayout
classes.description: Custom FrameLayout implementing Checkable to show selection state with background color.

classes.name: MultiChoiceModeListener
classes.description: Listener handling multi-choice action mode events, updating UI based on selection count.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads apps, and sets up the GridView with adapter and multi-choice mode.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries package manager for launchable activities to populate app list.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses view for each app icon, loading icon drawable.

methods.name: CheckableLayout.setChecked
methods.description: Sets background drawable based on checked state.

methods.name: MultiChoiceModeListener.onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Sets up action mode title and subtitle when multi-selection starts.

methods.name: MultiChoiceModeListener.onItemCheckedStateChanged
methods.description: Updates subtitle with number of selected items.
